caption: Ragbir v. United States
citation_line: Ragbir v. United States, No. 2:17-cv-01256, 2019 WL 1975462 (D.N.J. Jan. 25, 2019), aff'd, 950 F.3d 54 (3d Cir. 2020)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge McNulty denied coram nobis relief from a fraud conviction after an evidentiary hearing, rejecting ineffective-assistance and instructional claims advanced in an effort to avoid immigration consequences.
qualification_rationale: The appeal produced a detailed precedential synthesis of the ancient writ's modern five prerequisites, including a particularly strict sound-reasons-for-delay requirement in immigration-consequence cases.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed, holding that the petitioner had not supplied sound reasons for the long delay and clarifying the governing coram nobis framework.
